scenario_title: Blocking DB migration on a shared RDS database
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-04-01 10:13-13:53: api-gateway: 247 of 340 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-01 10:13 and 2026-04-01 13:53 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.756 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} ran a blocking migration on the meta-db servers table (RDS); writes queued behind the table lock and callers timed out. The hotfix patch applied afterwards did not touch the DB.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} runs DDL that rewrites servers under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
_templates.remediation: Cancel the migration / roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; re-run it online (CONCURRENTLY / nullable column, batched backfill); review meta-db sizing.

rca.macro: Deploy v3.12.0 of cloud-api ran a blocking migration on the meta-db servers table (RDS); writes queued behind the table lock and callers timed out. The hotfix patch applied afterwards did not touch the DB.
rca.micro: cloud-api/db/migrations/V40__servers_feat133.sql:2 runs DDL that rewrites servers under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
rca.remediation: Cancel the migration / roll back cloud-api v3.12.0 -> v3.11.0; re-run it online (CONCURRENTLY / nullable column, batched backfill); review meta-db sizing.

action_items: Add a regression test covering migration (cloud-api/db/migrations/V40__servers_feat133.sql).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
